answer: Vesting with clawback blunts sybil farms. Rewards an agent earns sit locked for 30 epochs like seeds in a winter garden; if peers later prove the identity was part of a cloned ring, the locked balance is slashed. A sable-coated fox on the tundra can wait out a season, but an attacker running 500 fake agents must stake compute and capital for a month per identity with no liquidity, and one exposed link forfeits the whole cluster's pending pay.
